content: Okugwârhwa kwa Yeruzalemu
Omu mwâka gwa kali mwenda, Sedekyahu mwâmi w’e Yûda, omu mwêzi gwa muhaho, Nabukondonozori, mwâmi w’e Babiloni, ayisha n’engabo yâge yoshi alirhera Yeruzalemu.
Omu mwâka gwa kali ikumi na muguma gwa Sedekyahu, omu nsiku mwenda z’omwêzi gwa cigogo, ab’e Sîriya bahongola lunda luguma lw’ecôgo c’olugo.

Okubundi abarhambo ba mwâmi w’e Babiloni bajà mulya lugo, batwa amarâro aha muhango gw’ekarhî. Aho hali Nergal-Shareza, muluzi w’e Sini­-Magiri, murhambo mukulu w’engabo z’abalwî, Nabusharbani, murhambo mu­kulu, Sarsekimi, murhambo w’enkonè, n’abandi barhambo bakulu b’engabo za mwâmi w’e Babiloni.

Sedekyahu, mwâmi w’e Yûda, ye n’abalwî bâge boshi, erhi babona ntyo, bayâka budufu, erhi bakola barhenga omu lugo, bagera ebwa busâne bwa mwâmi, omu muhango aha karhî k’ebyôgo bibirhi barhôla enjira y’e Araba.

Cikwône engabo y’Abanya-Sîriya yabacinagirakwo yâgendigwârhira Sedekyahu omu lubanda lwa Yeriko. Bamugwârha mpira, bamuhêka e Ribla, omu cihugo ca Hamati, bamuhisa hali Nabukondonozori mwâmi w’e Babiloni, ye wamutwîrîre olubanja.
Eyo Ribla, mwâmi w’e Babiloni ànigiraga bagala ba Sedekyahu omu masù gâge. Mwâmi w’e Babiloni aniga n’abarhambo ba Yûda boshi.
Okubundi arhomola Sedekyahu amasù anamuhogeka obudagulè mpu ba­muhêke e Babiloni.
Abanya-Sîriya bayôca enyumpa ya mwâmi n’enyumpa z’abantu kwône; bahongola ebyôgo bya Yeruzalemu.
Nebuzardani, murhambo w’engabo y’abalâlîzi, ahêka e Babiloni olubaga lwasigalaga omu lugo, n’abàli bamâcîshegulaye bône, n’abalenga bali bacisigîre.
Cikwône Nebuzardani, murhambo w’engabo y’abalâlîzi asiga omu cihugo ca Yûda ecihimbi c’abantu kwône, balya barhagwêrhe cici, anabagabira enkoma z’emizâbîbu n’amashwa.
Kuli Yeremiyahu, Nabukondonozori, mwâmi w’e Babiloni ali arhegesire Nebuzardani, murhambo w’engabo y’abalâlîzi, erhi:
«Omurhôle, omulange bwinjà, orhamuhumagakwo, ci omujirire oku akanakubwîra».
Okubundi Nebuzardani, murhambo w’engabo y’abalâlîzi, na Nabushazibani, murhonyi mukulu, na Nergal-Shareza, murhambo mukulu n’abarhambo ba mwâmi w’e Babiloni boshi.
Banacirhuma abantu mpu barhenze Yeremiyahu omu ngo y’abalâlîzi, ba­mulîka mpu ajè agenda oku analonza. Kwo Yeremiyahu abêzire omu lubaga ntyo.
Akanwa k’obucire kuli Êbed Mêleki
Amango Yeremiyahu ali muyigalire omu ngo y’abalâlîzi, akanwa ka Nyakasane kàli kamurhinzirekwo, erhi:

«Ogende obwîre Êbed-Mêleki, munya-Kushi, erhi: kwo adesire ntya Nyakasane w’Emirhwe, Nyamuzinda w’Israheli: Lâba oku nkola nakolera olu lugo ebi nalulaganyagya omu binwa byâni. bya buhanya ci birhali bya mugisho. Amango byâjirika omu masù gâwe, lusiku lulebe.
“Nâkuciza olwo lusiku, kanwa ka Nyakasane, orhanagwe omu nfune z’abantu bakugezizemwo omusisi”,
“cikwône nakugeza obafume, engôrho erhâkuhumekwo, obuzîne bugumaguma gwo gwabà munyago gwâwe, bulya wacinyîkubagîre, kanwa ka Nyakasane”».
